## Penalties

- [ ] **Invalid Cross-Check link** — The submitted cross-check link is not valid or is not a Pull Request link (**-20 points**)
- [ ] **Changes after deadline** — Changes were made after the deadline (**-40 points**)
- [ ] **Incorrect main/base branch name** — Main/base branch is named incorrectly and does not follow the repository workflow guidelines (**-20 points**)
- [ ] **Merged Cross-Check PR** — The submitted Cross-Check Pull Request has been merged into the target branch (**-30 points**)
- [ ] **Branching strategy violation** — Tasks were implemented directly in a single branch instead of using separate task branches (**-50 points**)
- [ ] **Prohibited libraries** — Prohibited libraries listed in the requirements are used (**-200 points**)
- [ ] **Layout implemented with images** — The entire layout or individual layout blocks are implemented using images (**-90 points**)
- [ ] **`console.log` calls** — `console.log` calls are present in the code (**-10 points per unique log, up to -30 points total**)
- [ ] **Git / PR style guide violation** — Commits or Pull Request description do not follow the RS School style guide (**-30 points**)
- [ ] **CSS magic values** — CSS properties are set with magic values instead of design tokens/constants (**-10 points per unique case, up to -50 points total**)
- [ ] **ESLint / Prettier errors** — ESLint or Prettier errors are present in the code (**-5 points per error**)
- [ ] **Explicit `any`** — Explicit `any` type is used in TypeScript (**-5 points per occurrence**)
